title: PERSONAL FINANCIAL LITERACY
description: This course provides a comprehensive foundation in personal financial planning, specifically tailored for graduate students. It offers an in-depth exploration of essential financial concepts and practical insights to effectively navigate the evolving job market, emphasizing the increasing importance of self-reliance in financial management. Participants will develop skills in value-based goal setting and leverage the latest technology, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), for enhanced decision-making. The curriculum includes strategic financial management topics such as budgeting, tax planning, choosing appropriate banking services, and making informed decisions on buying or leasing vehicles, as well as understanding the complexities of home purchases. Additionally, the course delves into investment strategies and retirement planning. With updated cultural, institutional, and tax-related information, coupled with current financial data and data analytics, the course ensures that students are well-equipped to make informed decisions for their financial futures in a dynamic world.
